import sys, random, time, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from perf import big_topology, big_plan
from crosscheck.topology import Topology
from crosscheck.predictions import normalize_routes
from crosscheck.repair import compute_repair
rng=random.Random(5)
# 128 nodes, degree 8, 512 links
topo_raw=big_topology(rng, nodes=128, links_target=512, degree=8, ext=16)
topo=Topology(topo_raw); print('flows', topo.flow_count, 'links', len(topo_raw['links']))
counters={k: rng.randint(0,10**6) for k in topo.counter_keys if rng.random()<0.7}
ext_ids=topo.external_ids
demands={}
for _ in range(400):
    s,d=rng.sample(ext_ids,2); demands[(s,d)]=rng.randint(0,10**6)
routes=normalize_routes(big_plan(rng,topo_raw))
t=time.time(); res=compute_repair(topo,counters,demands,routes,7,32,250000)
print('dense-degree repair %.2fs'%(time.time()-t))
# epsilon max, trials max
t=time.time(); res=compute_repair(topo,counters,demands,None,999,32,0)
print('null routes %.2fs'%(time.time()-t))
